corrections: Chairmanship belongs to Icahn Enterprises GP, general partner of the listed partnership; it is not the company CEO position. 1990 start supported by annual report.
Annual report listing Andrew Teno as CEO is superseded by May 6, 2026 appointment of Ted Papapostolou. Carl is not described as the outgoing company CEO.
Brett succession remains anticipated, not completed. Estate-plan conditional language does not report a death.
Princeton philosophy graduation is 1957; NYU medical-school attendance is not a medical degree. Exact duration omitted because accounts differ.
1968 Icahn & Co. founding is not founding of every later entity. Personal biography current holdings are stale and not copied.
Mount Sinai November 15, 2012 release records nearly $200 million cumulative giving; agreement November 13 and board approval September 24 are distinct. Not a new single $200 million donation.
Princeton 1999 gift is from family foundation for laboratory construction, not scientific discovery, academic appointment or the building opening.

August 19, 2024 SEC settlement: individual $500,000, IEP $1.5 million civil penalties, neither admitting nor denying findings. No criminal conviction, exoneration or validation of all short-seller claims implied.
November 3, 2026 quarterly release reports $225 million net loss attributable to IEP; this is not personal wealth loss. NAV, EBITDA and net income are not interchanged.
No personal net-worth ranking, universal investment-success claim or unverified contemporary attendance included.
Commons historical portrait caption differs from 2021 file metadata date. Claimed CC0 and author credit alone do not complete original-provenance, color or visual identity checks.
